# open-entity-gateway-lattice

An optional adapter for [open-entity-gateway](../../README.md) that publishes tracks as entities to Lattice through the Lattice SDK for Python. The SDK is not a dependency and is not distributed here: installing or using it accepts its vendor's licence agreement. Read [docs/adapters/lattice.md](../../docs/adapters/lattice.md) before installing it.

Status: built; not run against a Lattice environment.
